digest.component_or_area: opt-in verify gates (gate_enabled, plan-review close gate, completion close gate)
propositions: gate_enabled must raise ConfigError (chained from parse fault, naming gate label and ticket) instead of returning GateState.UNREADABLE on malformed rebar.toml
claim and close operations must fail loudly with ConfigError on unreadable config, leaving tickets in their pre-operation state (open for claim, in_progress for close)
close operation error must be raised before acquiring the write lock, ensuring no config work happens under the lock on the unreadable path
GateState.UNREADABLE becomes unreachable; ENABLED/DISABLED states and bool compatibility remain unchanged for existing test monkeypatches
CLI main() must catch ConfigError and print clean error message to stderr with exit 1, matching existing ConfigError handling from -c overrides
